Suppression envelope preview

Your supplied firing clips with a 250 Hz low-pass and a proposed 48 dB/octave slope. Compare dry, filtered-only, and filtered plus your unfiltered suppressed_shot.wav layer. Layer starts at 0.00s, at its original gain. The slope is an audition choice; “steep” has not yet been assigned a final value.

TimeWetDry
0.00s0%100%
0.04s100%0%
0.09s100%0%
0.18s25%75%
0.69s0%100%

Every segment is linear. The two equal 100% points necessarily form a flat plateau from .04–.09s. Playback uses original speed/pitch so these timestamps stay exact. This preview does not simulate zombie hearing or establish native-game DSP support.

Ready. Playback volume is 35%.
